core.title: Satin Nickel Ribbon Cabinet Pull, Laurey 38528

text.description_html:
Laurey 38528, Ribbon Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull

The Ribbon Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull is unique in that it can be mounted with either 3 inch mounting centers or 4 inch mounting centers. The Ribbon Satin Nickel Pull measures 5 inches overall. This lightweight cabinet pull is an affordable way to update your kitchen's hardware. Each cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting screws. The Ribbon Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull has a transitional style that is sure to catch eyes and turn heads.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Ribbon Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 38528 Ribbon Pull in Satin Nickel:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): Adjustable 3" or 4"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
